Name: Fish Feet
Author: daleonar
Description:
On May 28th, 2023, the youtuber, CharlieBarley, was nearing the end of a [url=https://www.youtube.com/live/ItiJSAnYOK0?t=8738s]stream[/url] of Pokemon themed Stardew Valley (shout out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16194]Mr. Pam[/url]) when she flubbed a bit by nearly saying shoes when she meant fish. Because of this she began to consider the idea of wearing fish as shoes and what sort of benefits might be offered. So, with her collaboration, this mod brings that idea to life and allows the player to wear the fish they catch on their feet for a variety of effects.

Charlie also [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6wO4xFn0FU4]streamed [/url]an exploration of the mod once it was finally in a semi-playable state, if you are interested is seeing what it has to offer.

Downloads.Description: There should be two mod folders here. One called Fish Feet which is the C# code that handles the fish effects. The other is Fish Boots which is the Content Patcher mod that makes new footwear for the fish to become.
